name: Upwork, Inc.
reason: Freelance marketplace facing credible AI disintermediation of core gig categories; EBIT margin 16.5% is a 10y high after years of losses and consensus sees FY1 EPS -1.4%.

name: Donnelley Financial Solutions, Inc.
reason: Revenue CAGR -3.1% over 10y with results tied to IPO/deal capital-markets activity and declining print; software shift is real but not special.

name: Herc Holdings, Inc.
reason: Cyclical equipment rental with net debt/EBITDA 5.5x after debt-funded H&E deal, FY25 EPS -41% and negative 10y FCF conversion (-0.86).

name: Kontoor Brands, Inc.
reason: Mature Wrangler/Lee denim with LTG ~2% and EPS at 10y high (margin 90th pctile); debt-funded Helly Hansen deal adds leverage - ordinary, no specialness.

name: CRH Plc
reason: Local-oligopoly aggregates/materials with EPS CAGR 18% over 10y (6/9 years >=7%), steady margin expansion to 14.2%, net debt/EBITDA 2.1x and US infrastructure tailwind; watch bolt-on M&A (acq/FCF 0.94) and peak margins.

name: International Seaways, Inc.
reason: Tanker earnings set by unforecastable charter rates; EBIT margin swung -26% to +54% in the decade and consensus FY2-FY3 EPS falls ~36%/yr.

name: Innovative Industrial Properties, Inc.
reason: Cannabis-tenant REIT exposed to tenant defaults and federal regulatory uncertainty; FFO/share fell 16% in 2025 to 6.78 from 8.20 peak.

name: Hamilton Lane, Inc.
reason: Private-markets solutions manager with sticky fee-based AUM from long-dated commitments, EPS CAGR 16.6% (4/5 years >=7%), EBIT margin 54%, no net debt and secular private-markets/evergreen growth; some carry and fundraising cyclicality.

name: Talos Energy, Inc.
reason: Offshore E&P driven by oil prices; EPS negative in 2024-25, share count CAGR 68% from acquisitions.

name: The Simply Good Foods Co.
reason: Atkins brand in decline with GLP-1 threat to diet/nutrition snacking and growth bought via Quest/OWYN (acq/FCF 2.03); ROIC 10y avg 4.5%.

name: Peabody Energy Corp.
reason: Coal miner with earnings set by seaborne coal prices; FY25 EPS -0.43 vs 8.29 in 2022 and secular decline in thermal coal.

name: Hess Midstream LP
reason: Fee-based Bakken gathering but effectively a single customer (Chevron/Hess), EBIT margin at 10y high 62%, net debt/EBITDA 3.1x and consensus FY2 EPS -8.5% as volumes plateau.

name: Warrior Met Coal, Inc.
reason: Met coal producer priced off seaborne met coal; EPS 1.09 in 2025 vs 12.88 in 2022 and only 1/7 years of >=7% growth.

name: Indivior Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
reason: Single-franchise opioid-use-disorder pharma (Sublocade) with history of opioid litigation, generic erosion of Suboxone and patent/reimbursement risk; 10y EPS CAGR only 3.9%.

name: Flutter Entertainment Plc
reason: FanDuel is a scale leader but state tax hikes, prediction-market competition and regulation make 5-10y earnings unforecastable; net debt/EBITDA 3.55x and acq/FCF 1.92.

name: National Energy Services Reunited Corp.
reason: MENA oilfield services tied to upstream capex cycles and Aramco spending; 10y ROIC avg 2.1% and EPS 0.52 below 2018 levels.

name: Magnolia Oil & Gas Corp.
reason: Eagle Ford E&P whose earnings are set by oil/gas prices; EPS 1.76 is 0.40x the 2022 peak.

name: Brighthouse Financial, Inc.
reason: Variable-annuity/life run-off book with opaque hedging and reserve marks (10y ROE avg -3.2%) and pending sale to Aquarian; cannot forecast.

name: Dropbox, Inc.
reason: Revenue stalling with paying users declining and AI/bundled-cloud commoditization threat; EPS growth driven by margin and debt-funded buybacks (net debt/EBITDA 3.0x, buybacks 1.1x FCF).

name: Cargurus, Inc.
reason: Most-visited US auto-listings marketplace with network effects, EPS CAGR 16% (7/8 years >=7%), no net debt, heavy buybacks and consensus 15-18% EPS growth; margin at 10y high 27% after CarOffer exit is the key risk.
